row:
Equine-Alignment care is a manual therapy that can restore correct biomechanical function and reduce or eliminate performance problems, acute or chronic pain, and health issues in horses.

By restoring the correct movement of the joints, particularly those of the spine, the animal becomes better able to maintain its own health and achieve its full potential within its field.

Equine-Alignment care should be used alongside traditional veterinary care to enhance the wellbeing of the horse. 

Steve Treloar's Equine Align care may help to:
Provide gentle musculoskeletal alignment for the enhancement of movement or performance, of your horse and Integrate its movement to enhance performance

Steve Treloar's qualifications include:
​
Bachelor of Applied Science (Chiropractor)
Cert BT—Certified Equine Bowen Therapist (ISBT)
Certified Equine Rehabilitation and Training (ACAAT)
